Before the conversation

A few details make a useful starting point.

These prompts can help you organize your questions before a call. They are not an assessment of your roof or a promise of a particular repair.

  1. 01

    What have you noticed?

    Describe the visible change or concern in your own words. If you already have photographs, note what they show.

  2. 02

    Where and when?

    Mention the part of the home involved and when you first noticed the issue. Include whether anything has changed since then.

  3. 03

    What would you like to discuss?

    Let the conversation begin with your questions about residential roof repair or roof inspection.
